Type: shelf
Name: Rivet Modern Floating Wall Mounted Shelving Decor - 9 Inch, Natural Wood and Gold (Renewed)
This wall unit offers a modern take on shelving with a single shelf held up by a crisscrossing, triangular iron frame. The rubberwood veneer gives this unit a convincing natural look, and the gold-colored iron provides a sense of luxury. 9.06"H x 24.6"W x 5.91"D 60% MDF with rubberwood veneer; 40% iron Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
